name: mod.yagens_attributes.argon_scope

capacity.description: Mod capacity used at level 0 and additional capacity per level. Total capacity cost is base + per_level * level.

max_level_description: Maximum inclusive Mod level. Level 0 is a usable Mod and every entry scales with (level + 1).

entries.description: Fractional critical chance Addition at rank 0. The bonus applies to shots fired during the buff and scales with (rank + 1).

condition.description: Confirmed ranged weak point hits build or refresh the weapon buff. The bonus applies at launch. scale_duration_with_rank multiplies the rank 0 duration by (rank + 1).
